title: FHFA House Price Index — monthly index (October 2027 data), 9:00 a.m. ET
source: EST: two FHFA primaries fetched direct 2026-09-06 and parsed in full by this session. (1) fhfa.gov/data/hpi (HTTP 200, 89,663 bytes) -- its "2027 HPI Release Dates" table, twelfth and last of the dated rows, reads verbatim "Tuesday, December 28 | Monthly Index | October 2027". (2) The published 2026Q2 report (HTTP 200, 1,522,949 bytes, released 2026-08-25), whose "FHFA HPI Release Dates for 2027" appendix page carries the identical row above the statement "Public FHFA HPI(R) releases occur at 9AM ET and include a press release, tables, figures, and associated data" -- a published document, not a second reading of the same web table, and the source of the 9:00 a.m. ET time. THE EDITION TYPE IS QUOTED RATHER THAN ASSUMED: the same table marks only February 23, May 25, August 31 and November 30 as "Quarterly Index (with Monthly Tables)", and December is not one of them. 2027-12-28 is the last Tuesday of December 2027 and a full NYSE session, consistent with the rule all twelve 2027 rows follow. Filed estimate because a proposal is always estimate by contract, and because this calendar's confirmed-tier prefixes have no member for a federal statistical agency's own posted forward calendar; the page and the report are both primary sources and a published 2027 schedule, which is stronger than the estimate label suggests. Promote on an independent second look by whichever lane takes this id, per the no-self-confirm convention eight sibling lanes have followed. Discovered during the fhfa-hpi-2027-10-26 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the fhfa-hpi-2027-10-26 initial research (2026-09-06), which read the FHFA 2027 release table in full from two primaries. With this proposal and its sibling fhfa-hpi-2027-11-30.from-fhfa-hpi-2027-10-26.json, ALL TWELVE 2027 FHFA EDITIONS ARE NOW EITHER TRACKED OR PROPOSED -- 2027-12-28 was the last untracked one. THREE THINGS FOR WHOEVER TAKES THIS ID. (1) DECEMBER IS A CLEAR MONTH ON EVERY AXIS THE PROPOSER MEASURED. The last Tuesday of December falls inside an FOMC communications blackout 0 of 7 across 2021-2027, and is an FOMC day one 0 of 7 -- so unlike the January, April, July and October editions this one needs no blackout control, and unlike its October sibling it carries no Fed collision. It does still share its morning with the Conference Board's 10:00 print, which is an identity covering 67 of 67 post-policy FHFA releases and not a feature of this date (fhfa-hpi-2027-09-28's Leg 2). (2) THE OCTOBER 2027 REFERENCE MONTH IS ALREADY REFUTED AS A SOURCE OF EDGE. fhfa-hpi-2026-12-29 tested October m/m and killed it at p=0.8091; six reference months are now refuted in total (June, July, August, October, November, December). A seventh test of a closed hypothesis is not a finding. The genuinely uncertain number remains the m/m against the LIVE regime, which as of 2026-06 is flat -- last six readings 4 of 6 positive, median about +0.084%. (3) THE CLEAN INTRADAY WINDOW EXISTS NOW AND IS DOCUMENTED IN THE PROPOSER'S LEG 2 -- Yahoo 1h bars with includePrePost serve a 09:00-09:30 ET pre-market bar excluding the 10:00 Conference Board print, with 34 release mornings in sample as of 2026-09-04 and roughly sixteen more by this date. Its limits are documented there: release day equals last Tuesday 34 of 34 so the slot cannot be separated from the print, pre-market volume is not served, and 30m/5m intervals are capped at 60 days. Same channel caveat as every FHFA entry: symbols is empty and no house playbook is housing- or macro-keyed. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
